title: Closeout summary: Refresh subject context pack on every mutating command
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_51a4e68e4d3ca9d5
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: getContextPack serves whatever projection is persisted with no freshness check (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 941-950); packs are rebuilt only by context rebuild, doctor --fix, claim-time handoff (apps/cli/src/commands.ts line 11021) and finishReservedWork (runtime.ts line 799 via refreshWorkContext at lines 1731-1744). Plain evidence add, work verify, work close and work edit leave the subject pack stale, so context show silently returns outdated facts between rebuilds. WHAT: call refreshWorkContext (it already exists) for the affected subject inside recordEvidence, verifyWork, closeWork and the work edit path, and stamp generatedAt prominently in context show text output so consumers can detect drift. Cost is one pack build per mutation, which is acceptable at current scale; note the existing rebuild-the-world pattern in rebuildProjections is out of scope here.

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_96d83c3bd4c33e65: passed Implemented context-pack refresh after evidence, verification, close, and work edit mutations in checkpoint ffa6c80a; pnpm check and runtime tests passed.
